suites.name: marco_benchmark
suites.description: Viper programs from several front ends (Gobra, Nagini, Prusti, VerCors, ...); one family per source collection

families.name: DaG
families.description: Gobra versions of examples from a verification textbook (the Dafny book)

families.name: DaV
families.description: Viper versions of examples from a verification textbook (the Dafny book)

families.name: Flo
families.description: Flow-framework proofs of graph data structures (B-tree, lists, hash table, Harris list, Dijkstra, ...) in `acyclic` and `last-edge` variants, most with a `-buggy` counterpart; not one of the paper's groups

families.name: Go
families.description: Smaller Go programs encoded by Gobra

families.name: GoC
families.description: Larger Gobra case studies proving correctness and security of real-world security protocol implementations (SCION, WireGuard)

families.name: PP
families.description: Product-program encoding proving a 3-safety hyperproperty; light heap use, heavy branching

families.name: Py
families.description: Python programs encoded by Nagini, including two case studies proving complex functional properties

families.name: PyP
families.description: Nagini programs with a product-program encoding proving information flow security of the Python source

families.name: Rea
families.description: Reachability properties of graph-manipulating programs; heavy use of heap-dependent functions and quantified resources

families.name: RSL
families.description: Weak-memory programs generated by a frontend for Relaxed Separation Logic

families.name: Ru1
families.description: Rust programs verified with Prusti; heavy use of predicates and magic wands, no quantified resources

families.name: Ru2
families.description: Unsafe Rust encoded by a prototype Viper frontend; heavily mutates the heap

families.name: Ru3
families.description: Unsafe Rust encoded by a second prototype Viper frontend; does not use Viper's heap at all

families.name: SC
families.description: Smart contracts encoded by 2vyper; no use of Viper's heap

families.name: SCR
families.description: Smart contracts encoded by 2vyper with resources; quantified resources and many branches

families.name: VeC
families.description: VerCors encodings from larger case studies of Java and CUDA programs, plus examples in VerCors's PVL language

families.name: VeV
families.description: VerCors-encoded examples from the VerifyThis competition

families.name: Vi
families.description: Programs written directly in Viper, incl. examples from publications on quantified resources and magic wands, and VerifyThis

families.name: Vo
families.description: Heap-heavy examples generated by Voila, a frontend for the fine-grained concurrency logic TaDA

suites.name: scaling
suites.description: Generated scaling families: one knob varies, everything else is held fixed (gen_*.py)

families.name: depth
families.description: Nested if-blocks: nesting depth x statements per block

families.name: enum
families.description: Payload enums: variant count x payload nesting depth; every arm writes through a `&mut` payload

families.name: loops
families.description: Nested loops: loop nesting depth x statements per loop body

families.name: seq_if
families.description: Two-way branches in sequence (2^K paths), each writing through a `&mut`

families.name: args_value
families.description: Functions taking N `Cell` arguments by value

families.name: args_ref
families.description: Functions taking N `&Cell` arguments

families.name: args_mut
families.description: Functions taking N `&mut Cell` arguments, each written through

families.name: call_depth
families.description: Call chain of depth D, passing one `&mut` down

families.name: call_fanout
families.description: One function calling F distinct helpers with the same `&mut`

families.name: mut_writes
families.description: Writes through one `&mut`: write count x field path length

families.name: arith
families.description: Straight-line block of K arithmetic ops, half of them checked divisions/remainders

families.name: struct_depth
families.description: Struct nesting depth D: leaf writes unfold D predicate levels

families.name: struct_width
families.description: One struct with W fields, each read and written

families.name: tuple_width
families.description: One W-element tuple, projected element by element and rebuilt

families.name: enum_tag
families.description: Fieldless enum with N variants, matched and constructed

families.name: enum_fields
families.description: Struct with N enum-typed fields, each decided by its own match

families.name: option_depth
families.description: `Option` nested D deep, peeled by D nested matches

families.name: nway
families.description: One integer `match` with K arms rejoining at one block

families.name: seqmatch
families.description: K correlated if-then-match pairs in sequence

families.name: reborrow
families.description: N sequential reborrow-write pairs on one `&mut`

families.name: condmove
families.description: K sequential conditional moves of one local (2^K paths)

families.name: generic
families.description: K round-trips of a value through a generic identity function

families.name: impls
families.description: K impls of one trait, only one of them used

families.name: units
families.description: K independent small functions per file (program size)

families.name: straight
families.description: K statements in one straight-line body (method size)

families.name: pcalias
families.description: Viper-only: K fractional chunks that alias only under the path condition
